s0101.literal: Sixth month, on renzi day envoys were dispatched along separate routes to seek out and measure gnomon shadows, solar and lunar eclipses, and calendrical methods.
s0101.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day envoys were sent along separate routes to seek out and measure gnomon shadows, solar and lunar eclipses, and calendrical methods.

s0102.literal: Official salaries were increased; calculating by tenths, those receiving less than one ingot received an increase of five-tenths.
s0102.idiomatic: Official salaries were increased; calculating by tenths, those receiving less than one ingot received a five-tenths increase.

s0103.literal: On jiayin day an edict enfeoffed the imperial prince Tuohuan as Prince of Zhennan, granted him a gilded silver seal, and stationed him at Ezhou.
s0103.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict enfeoffed Prince Tuohuan as Prince of Zhennan, granted him a gilded silver seal, and stationed him at Ezhou.

s0104.literal: On gengshen day the Mongol Grand Marshal's Office was changed to the Mongol Chief Ten-Thousand Household Office, the Artillery Marshal's Office to the Artillery Ten-Thousand Household Office, and the Chief Artillery Marshal's Office to the Muslim Artillery Army Artisan Ten-Thousand Household Office.
s0104.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Mongol grand marshal's office was made the Mongol chief ten-thousand household office, the artillery marshal's office the artillery ten-thousand household office, and the chief artillery marshal's office the Muslim artillery army artisan ten-thousand household office.

s0105.literal: On jiazi day sixty troops under Yesudai'er's command were ordered to pan for gold at Shuangcheng.
s0105.idiomatic: On jiazi day 60 troops under Yesudai'er were ordered to pan for gold at Shuangcheng.

s0106.literal: At Handasun's request, Alatai and the Helin garrison farm troops were transferred and combined with his own troops to farm at Wuhe.
s0106.idiomatic: At Handasun's request, Alatai and the Helin garrison farm troops were transferred and combined with his command to farm at Wuhe.

s0107.literal: On yichou day the Zhongwei garrison farms suffered locusts.
s0107.idiomatic: On yichou day the Zhongwei garrison farms suffered locusts.

s0108.literal: On jiaxu day paper currency of twenty-one thousand six hundred forty-three ingots was granted to Prince Aiyachi's keshig guard Zhejie and others and to the households under Wulahai, and ten thousand two hundred forty-six ingots to Prince Namuhe's keshig guard and keling retainers.
s0108.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 21,643 ingots of paper currency were granted to Prince Aiyachi's keshig guard Zhejie and others and to the households under Wulahai, and 10,246 ingots to Prince Namuhe's keshig guard and keling retainers.

s0109.literal: Ten thousand one hundred ninety-five horses and ten thousand sixty sheep were granted to the impoverished troops under Dorokhai Zhalaier.
s0109.idiomatic: 10,195 horses and 10,060 sheep were granted to the impoverished troops under Dorokhai Zhalaier.

s0110.literal: Seventh month, autumn, dingchou new moon: an edict ordered the Jinghu and Xichuan provinces to combine forces and suppress the Chaba and Sanmao cave barbarians.
s0110.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou new moon, an edict ordered Jinghu and Xichuan to combine forces and suppress the Chaba and Sanmao cave barbarians.

s0111.literal: Yunnan provincial officials said: "Tengyue, Yongchang, and Luobidan have disloyal populations; Yesudai'er or Commander-in-Chief Wang should be sent with troops to suppress them.
s0111.idiomatic: Yunnan provincial officials said, "Tengyue, Yongchang, and Luobidan have disloyal populations; Yesudai'er or Commander-in-Chief Wang should be sent with troops to suppress them.

s0113.literal: " Troops were ordered from the Privy Council to repair Dadu city.
s0113.idiomatic: " The Privy Council was ordered to dispatch troops to repair Dadu city.

s0114.literal: On jimao day the Yanfu Office was established.
s0114.idiomatic: On jimao day the Yanfu Office was established.

s0115.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "The title of chancellor should not be lightly bestowed.
s0115.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "The title of chancellor should not be lightly bestowed.

s0116.literal: Champa provincial officials already number seven; they should be reduced.
s0116.idiomatic: Champa provincial officials already number seven; they should be cut.

s0117.literal: " An edict forbade military officers from holding concurrent chancellor titles.
s0117.idiomatic: " An edict forbade military officers from holding concurrent chancellor titles.

s0118.literal: The seal of Prince of Beian was granted to the imperial prince.
s0118.idiomatic: The Prince of Beian seal was granted to the imperial prince.

s0119.literal: The Yangzhou Crafts Supervisorate was restored.
s0119.idiomatic: The Yangzhou crafts supervisorate was restored.

s0120.literal: On dinghai day the Jianghuai branch secretariat sent Tabanda Lianzha, dispatched by Champa, to court and submitted its territorial map.
s0120.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Jianghuai branch secretariat sent Tabanda Lianzha, dispatched by Champa, to court and submitted Champa's territorial map.

s0121.literal: Talachi said: "When King Tounaike went out to garrison Goryeo, four hundred troops under Wangsu and others were mobilized; now Tounaike has returned but four hundred troops remain on Tamna, separated from their wives and children for a long time; other troops should be rotated to garrison there.
s0121.idiomatic: Talachi said, "When King Tounaike went out to garrison Goryeo, 400 troops under Wangsu and others were mobilized; now Tounaike has returned but 400 troops remain on Tamna, separated from their wives and children for a long time; other troops should be rotated to garrison there.

s0122.literal: " Bayan and others deliberated that a thousand Goryeo troops should garrison Tamna and the four hundred left behind be released to return home; this was approved.
s0122.idiomatic: " Bayan and others deliberated that 1,000 Goryeo troops should garrison Tamna and the 400 left behind be released to return home; this was approved.

s0123.literal: On wuzi day an edict ordered Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan to campaign against Champa.
s0123.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict ordered Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan to campaign against Champa.

s0124.literal: The detained Annam envoys Li Ying and others were sent back to their country; Ri Xuan dispatched his Central Grandee Ruan Daoxue and others to present local products.
s0124.idiomatic: The detained Annam envoys Li Ying and others were sent home; Ri Xuan dispatched his Central Grandee Ruan Daoxue and others to present local products.

s0125.literal: Commander-in-Chief Wang Weizheng said: "Many brothers of one family serve in office; I ask that the Convenient Chief Commanderate be reestablished at Qin and Gong Prefectures, still using the marshal's seal, with one of four brothers chosen as commander-in-chief, who would also concurrently hold the prefectural office under the commander-in-chief.
s0125.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Wang Weizheng said, "Many brothers of one family serve in office; I ask that the convenient chief commanderate be reestablished at Qin and Gong prefectures, still using the marshal's seal, with one of four brothers chosen as commander-in-chief who would also concurrently hold the prefectural office under the commander-in-chief.

s0126.literal: Of the two Wang clansmen commanding troops in Xichuan, one should be chosen as wanhu and the rest transferred according to regulation.
s0126.idiomatic: Of the two Wang clansmen commanding troops in Xichuan, one should be chosen as wanhu and the rest transferred according to regulation.

s0128.literal: Paper currency totaling seven thousand four hundred eighty ingots was granted to the impoverished Aruhun, Yulong Temur, and others.
s0128.idiomatic: Paper currency totaling 7,480 ingots was granted to the impoverished Aruhun, Yulong Temur, and others.

s0129.literal: Eighth month, dingwei day: Yunnan branch secretariat officials said: "At Huatie, Baishui River, and Yanjing the native Lao barbarians rebelled and killed princes and branch secretariat envoys.
s0129.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingwei day, Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "At Huatie, Baishui River, and Yanjing the native Lao barbarians rebelled and killed princes and branch secretariat envoys.

s0130.literal: " A thousand troops were mobilized to suppress them.
s0130.idiomatic: " 1,000 troops were mobilized to suppress them.

s0131.literal: Regulations for military officers were fixed: Heixi, Muslim, and Uyghur persons according to their official rank would serve as darughachi of ten-thousand household offices, the same as Mongols; Jurchen and Khitan the same as Han.
s0131.idiomatic: Regulations for military officers were fixed: Heixi, Muslim, and Uyghur persons according to rank would serve as darughachi of ten-thousand household offices, the same as Mongols; Jurchen and Khitan the same as Han.

s0132.literal: If Jurchen or Khitan born in the northwest did not understand Chinese, they would be treated the same as Mongols;
s0132.idiomatic: If Jurchen or Khitan born in the northwest did not understand Chinese, they would be treated the same as Mongols;

s0133.literal: Jurchen raised in Han territory would be treated the same as Han.
s0133.idiomatic: Jurchen raised in Han territory would be treated the same as Han.

s0134.literal: On jiyou day censorate officials said: "Unregistered troops wishing to join the army for looting were initially lent to bolster the crossing-the-river military prestige; now each holds bow and arrow and plunders civilians; if they are not assigned to separate wings, other disturbances may arise.
s0134.idiomatic: On jiyou day censorate officials said, "Unregistered troops wishing to join the army for looting were initially lent to bolster the crossing-the-river military prestige; now each holds bow and arrow and plunders civilians; if they are not assigned to separate wings, other disturbances may arise.

s0135.literal: " An edict sent them back to their homes.
s0135.idiomatic: " An edict sent them back to their homes.

s0136.literal: On xinhai day Eastern Expedition Pacification Commissioner Nie Gudai said: "There was an order to advance against Guwei, but the three armies of Ala Haiya, Duoladai, and Yudian all arrived late.
s0136.idiomatic: On xinhai day Eastern Expedition pacification commissioner Nie Gudai said, "There was an order to advance against Guwei, but the three armies of Ala Haiya, Duoladai, and Yudian all arrived late.

s0137.literal: After the seventh month winds at sea are high, supply ships heavy; deeply fearing the unforeseen, it should temporarily be delayed somewhat.
s0137.idiomatic: After the seventh month winds at sea are high and supply ships heavy; deeply fearing the unforeseen, it should temporarily be delayed somewhat.

s0139.literal: The king of Champa asked that Suodu's army be withdrawn, pledging annual tribute of local products; eleven persons including Taipan Yaluorijiayi and Daban sent a memorial to court and presented three elephants.
s0139.idiomatic: The king of Champa asked that Suodu's army be withdrawn, pledging annual tribute of local products; 11 persons including Taipan Yaluorijiayi and Daban sent a memorial to court and presented three elephants.

s0140.literal: On jiazi day the Fujian She troops were discharged, their weapons collected, and their chiefs transferred to civil offices in nearby prefectures and counties.
s0140.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Fujian She troops were discharged, their weapons collected, and their chiefs transferred to civil offices in nearby prefectures and counties.

s0141.literal: On gengwu day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.
s0141.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor returned from the Upper Capital.

s0142.literal: On jiaxu day Shuowan memorialized: "Jiandu woman Shazhi Zhidao had merit establishing relay stations; she was already granted a tiger tally and put in charge of households her father originally received upon submission as wanhu.
s0142.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Shuowan memorialized, "Jiandu woman Shazhi Zhidao had merit establishing relay stations; she had already been granted a tiger tally and put in charge of households her father originally received upon submission as wanhu.

s0143.literal: She is now made prefect of Jianchang Route and still wears the tiger tally.
s0143.idiomatic: She is now made prefect of Jianchang Route and still wears the tiger tally.

s0145.literal: Ninth month, jiashen day: the capital suffered an earthquake.
s0145.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen day, the capital suffered an earthquake.

s0146.literal: The maritime trade offices were merged into the salt transport commission and the Fujian Salt Tax and Maritime Trade Chief Transport Commission was established.
s0146.idiomatic: The maritime trade offices were merged into the salt transport commission and the Fujian salt tax and maritime trade chief transport commission was established.

s0147.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Fujian branch secretariat military provisions are extremely scarce and must be transshipped from Yangzhou, causing many delays.
s0147.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Fujian branch secretariat military provisions are extremely scarce and must be transshipped from Yangzhou, causing many delays.

s0148.literal: If the two provinces are merged into one and provincial officials are separately charged with governing Quanzhou, it would be convenient.
s0148.idiomatic: If the two provinces are merged into one and provincial officials are separately charged with governing Quanzhou, it would be convenient.

s0149.literal: " An edict made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat and branch secretariat minister Mangudai pacification commissioner of the Jianghuai and other places branch secretariat; branch secretariat left vice chancellors Hulachu and Pu Shougeng and associate administrator Guan Rude were separately to govern Quanzhou.
s0149.idiomatic: " An edict made Central Secretariat right vice chancellor and branch secretariat minister Mangudai pacification commissioner of the Jianghuai and other places branch secretariat; branch secretariat left vice chancellors Hulachu and Pu Shougeng and associate administrator Guan Rude were separately to govern Quanzhou.

s0150.literal: On guisi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0150.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0151.literal: On bingshen day Yang Lianzhenjia, chief controller of Jiangnan, was ordered to use gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Song imperial tombs to repair the Tianyi Temple.
s0151.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yang Lianzhenjia, chief controller of Jiangnan, was ordered to use gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Song imperial tombs to repair the Tianyi Temple.

s0152.literal: On jiachen day Hainan presented a white tiger, lions, and peacocks.
s0152.idiomatic: On jiachen day Hainan presented a white tiger, lions, and peacocks.

s0153.literal: Tenth month, winter, dingwei day: offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0153.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingwei day, offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0154.literal: On wushen day Sichuan branch secretariat officials said many Jinchi survivors had not yet submitted; Yaolihai was ordered to lead two thousand tamma cavalry to suppress them.
s0154.idiomatic: On wushen day Sichuan branch secretariat officials said many Jinchi survivors had not yet submitted; Yaolihai was ordered to lead 2,000 tamma cavalry to suppress them.

s0155.literal: On jiyou day an edict said: "Wanhu who serve as branch secretariat pacification envoys shall not concurrently command military affairs;
s0155.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict said, "Wanhu who serve as branch secretariat pacification envoys shall not concurrently command military affairs;

s0156.literal: Those who remain wanhu shall not concurrently administer civil government.
s0156.idiomatic: Those who remain wanhu shall not concurrently administer civil government.

s0157.literal: " On renzi day regulations for garrison farms at Lianhai and other places were fixed.
s0157.idiomatic: " On renzi day regulations for garrison farms at Lianhai and other places were fixed.

s0158.literal: On xinyou day the Eastern Expedition Pacification Commission sent troops to campaign against Guwei.
s0158.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Eastern Expedition pacification commission sent troops to campaign against Guwei.

s0159.literal: Song had hand-tattoo troops who upon death were succeeded by brothers or sons; an edict ordered them registered like Han troops, without marking their hands.
s0159.idiomatic: Song had hand-tattoo troops who upon death were succeeded by brothers or sons; an edict ordered them registered like Han troops, without marking their hands.

s0160.literal: On dingmao day Huluhuosun requested establishing the civil service examinations; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate; when Huluhuosun was dismissed the matter was dropped.
s0160.idiomatic: On dingmao day Huluhuosun requested establishing the civil service examinations; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate; when Huluhuosun was dismissed the matter was dropped.

s0161.literal: Pacification commissioner Zhang Wan was made Burma expedition pacification commissioner and granted a three-pearl tiger tally.
s0161.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Zhang Wan was made Burma expedition pacification commissioner and granted a three-pearl tiger tally.

s0162.literal: On wuchen day an Ever-Normal Granary was established, funded with paper currency worth five hundred thousand shi.
s0162.idiomatic: On wuchen day an Ever-Normal Granary was established, funded with paper currency worth 500,000 shi.

s0163.literal: On jiaxu day an edict instructed branch secretariats that for ships and veteran boatmen for the Japan expedition, all were to be recruited at increased rates paid by the state.
s0163.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict instructed branch secretariats that ships and veteran boatmen for the Japan expedition were to be recruited at increased rates paid by the state.

s0164.literal: Paper currency of fourteen thousand three ingots was granted to the impoverished Yashi, Xinducha, and others.
s0164.idiomatic: Paper currency of 14,003 ingots was granted to the impoverished Yashi, Xinducha, and others.

s0165.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen day: Nanmuli and Manggechi were enfeoffed as commandery dukes.
s0165.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen day, Nanmuli and Manggechi were enfeoffed as commandery dukes.

s0166.literal: On wuzi day the Beijing Pacification Commission was ordered to repair the Luan River channel.
s0166.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Beijing pacification commission was ordered to repair the Luan River channel.

s0167.literal: On jichou day Jiangxi branch secretariat associate administrator Yedeshimi captured the pirate Li De and induced one hundred thirty-three remaining followers to surrender; Li De was executed on the spot as a warning, and Li De's brother Li Hao and the false pacification commissioner Wu Xing were caged and sent to the capital.
s0167.idiomatic: On jichou day Jiangxi branch secretariat associate administrator Yedeshimi captured the pirate Li De and induced 133 remaining followers to surrender; Li De was executed on the spot as a warning, and Li De's brother Li Hao and the false pacification commissioner Wu Xing were caged and sent to the capital.

s0168.literal: Officials listed for transfer who did not take up their posts were ordered to return to farming and corvée duty.
s0168.idiomatic: Officials listed for transfer who did not take up their posts were ordered to return to farming and corvée duty.

s0169.literal: On gengyin day the king of Champa dispatched envoys including Daluopan Yaluorijiayi to present a memorial congratulating the Emperor's birthday, offering ceremonial gifts and two elephants; the former Champa old-district chief Baojialou also submitted a memorial and came to submit.
s0169.idiomatic: On gengyin day the king of Champa dispatched envoys including Daluopan Yaluorijiayi to present a memorial congratulating the Emperor's birthday, offering ceremonial gifts and two elephants; the former Champa old-district chief Baojialou also submitted a memorial and came to submit.

s0170.literal: On gengzi day Fan Wenhu was made left vice chancellor to deliberate on Privy Council affairs.
s0170.idiomatic: On gengzi day Fan Wenhu was made left vice chancellor to deliberate on privy council affairs.

s0171.literal: The moon transgressed the Heart constellation.
s0171.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

s0172.literal: On xinchou day Huluhuosun, Maishuding, Zhang Xiongfei, and Wendihan were all dismissed.
s0172.idiomatic: On xinchou day Huluhuosun, Maishuding, Zhang Xiongfei, and Wendihan were all dismissed.

s0173.literal: Former right chancellor Antong was restored as right chancellor; former Jiangxi tea monopoly transport commissioner Lu Shirong as right vice chancellor; former censor-in-chief Shi Shu as left vice chancellor; Buluosihaiya and Sadeshimi as associate administrators; former minister of revenue Baijiang as deliberator of Central Secretariat affairs.
s0173.idiomatic: Former right chancellor Antong was restored as right chancellor; former Jiangxi tea monopoly transport commissioner Lu Shirong as right vice chancellor; former censor-in-chief Shi Shu as left vice chancellor; Buluosihaiya and Sadeshimi as associate administrators; former minister of revenue Baijiang as deliberator of Central Secretariat affairs.

s0174.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to rectify paper currency law, fix gold and silver prices, forbid private exchange, and punish officials who did not diligently enforce it.
s0174.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to rectify paper currency law, fix gold and silver prices, forbid private exchange, and punish officials who did not diligently enforce it.

s0175.literal: On renyin day Antong and Lu Shirong said: "Officials great and small employed during Ahmad's monopoly on power were all dismissed by memorial; among them were surely not lacking capable men?
s0175.idiomatic: On renyin day Antong and Lu Shirong said, "Officials great and small employed during Ahmad's monopoly on power were all dismissed by memorial; among them were surely not lacking capable men?

s0176.literal: Those who can be used should be selected and still employed.
s0176.idiomatic: Those who can be used should be selected and still employed.

s0177.literal: " An edict ordered selection and reduction as stated, without favoring personal connections.
s0177.idiomatic: " An edict ordered selection and reduction as stated, without favoring personal connections.

s0178.literal: On guimao day the Fujian branch secretariat dispatched envoys into Baherusi to induce the four countries of Nanwuli, Bielili, Lilun, and Dali to submit; each sent its chancellor with a memorial and local products as tribute.
s0178.idiomatic: On guimao day the Fujian branch secretariat dispatched envoys into Baherusi to induce the four countries of Nanwuli, Bielili, Lilun, and Dali to submit; each sent its chancellor with a memorial and local products as tribute.

s0179.literal: As between the Yangzi and Huai there were many abandoned fields from Xiangyang to the Eastern Sea, the Ministry of Agriculture was ordered to establish garrison farm regulations, recruiting people to open and cultivate them, exempting them from six years of land tax and all miscellaneous corvée.
s0179.idiomatic: As between the Yangzi and Huai there were many abandoned fields from Xiangyang to the Eastern Sea, the Ministry of Agriculture was ordered to establish garrison farm regulations, recruiting people to open and cultivate them, exempting them from six years of land tax and all miscellaneous corvée.

s0180.literal: Paper currency of one hundred twenty-four thousand seven hundred twenty-two ingots was granted to the impoverished Mongols Yeligu, Xieliehai, Chajier, and others.
s0180.idiomatic: Paper currency of 124,722 ingots was granted to the impoverished Mongols Yeligu, Xieliehai, Chajier, and others.

s0181.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: Central Secretariat officials said: "Much Jiangnan official land has been concealed by powerful families, temples, and monasteries; accumulated income should be remitted, a deadline set, and confession permitted; those reported after the deadline should pay half to the informer.
s0181.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen new moon, Central Secretariat officials said, "Much Jiangnan official land has been concealed by powerful families, temples, and monasteries; accumulated income should be remitted, a deadline set, and confession permitted; those reported after the deadline should pay half to the informer.

s0183.literal: An Ever-Normal Salt Office was established.
s0183.idiomatic: An Ever-Normal Salt Office was established.

s0184.literal: On yisi day Cui Yu said Lu Shirong should not serve as chancellor; contradicting the imperial will he was dismissed.
s0184.idiomatic: On yisi day Cui Yu said Lu Shirong should not serve as chancellor; contradicting the imperial will he was dismissed.

s0185.literal: Ten thousand able-bodied men were used to open the Shenshan River and a ten-thousand household office established to oversee it.
s0185.idiomatic: 10,000 able-bodied men were used to open the Shenshan River and a ten-thousand household office established to oversee it.

s0186.literal: On xinhai day the Ceremonial Music Office was placed under the Court of Imperial Regalia.
s0186.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Ceremonial Music Office was placed under the Court of Imperial Regalia.

s0187.literal: On guihai day Lu Shirong said: "Wealthy households in the capital brew wine that is costly and thin-flavored, causing tax not to be paid on time; all private brewing should be forbidden and the state should sell wine itself; the former annual tax could be raised in one month.
s0187.idiomatic: On guihai day Lu Shirong said, "Wealthy households in the capital brew wine that is costly and thin-flavored, causing tax not to be paid on time; all private brewing should be forbidden and the state should sell wine itself; the former annual tax could be raised in one month.

s0189.literal: On jiazi day the Goryeo supervisorate was placed under the Ministry of Works.
s0189.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Goryeo supervisorate was placed under the Ministry of Works.

s0190.literal: On yichou day the Grand One was sacrificed to.
s0190.idiomatic: On yichou day the Grand One was sacrificed to.

s0191.literal: On bingyin day the Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat sent Liu Jichang of the Eight Banners to induce Longchangning, Longyanwan, and others to come to court; they presented sheep, horses, and white felt as tribute and each was granted the pacification commissionership of his locality.
s0191.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat sent Liu Jichang of the Eight Banners to induce Longchangning, Longyanwan, and others to come to court; they presented sheep, horses, and white felt as tribute and each was granted the pacification commissionership of his locality.

s0192.literal: A pacification commission was established to win over chieftains of the southwestern barbarians and other places.
s0192.idiomatic: A pacification commission was established to win over chieftains of the southwestern barbarians and other places.

s0193.literal: On guiyou day Hanlin Academician Sariman and Hanlin and Academy Grand Academician Xu Guozhen were ordered to gather medical professors from all routes to revise and enlarge the Materia Medica.
s0193.idiomatic: On guiyou day Hanlin Academician Sariman and Hanlin and Academy Grand Academician Xu Guozhen were ordered to gather medical professors from all routes to revise and enlarge the Materia Medica.

s0194.literal: That month Prince of Zhennan's army reached Annam, killed its garrison troops, and advanced in six columns; the Annam Prince of Xingdao resisted at Wanjie; advance troops defeated him; wanhu Ni Run died in battle at Liucun.
s0194.idiomatic: That month Prince of Zhennan's army reached Annam, killed its garrison troops, and advanced in six columns; the Annam Prince of Xingdao resisted at Wanjie; advance troops defeated him; wanhu Ni Run died in battle at Liucun.

s0195.literal: Jing Prefecture was placed under the Chief Commanderate and paper currency of two thousand eight hundred eighty-five ingots and forty ingots of silver were granted to the impoverished Mongol Wumaer and others.
s0195.idiomatic: Jing Prefecture was placed under the chief commanderate and 2,885 ingots of paper currency and 40 ingots of silver were granted to the impoverished Mongol Wumaer and others.

s0196.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, on wuyin day an edict announcing the appointment of chancellors was issued throughout the realm.
s0196.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on wuyin day of the first month of spring, an edict announcing the appointment of chancellors was issued throughout the realm.

s0197.literal: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, bamboo goods of the Huaimeng routes, and river and lake fishing profits south of the Yangzi and Huai were all relaxed from prohibition.
s0197.idiomatic: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, bamboo goods of the Huaimeng routes, and river and lake fishing profits south of the Yangzi and Huai were all relaxed from prohibition.

s0198.literal: Food and drink at relay stations everywhere was supplied by the state.
s0198.idiomatic: Food and drink at relay stations everywhere was supplied by the state.

s0199.literal: Officials were dispatched on all routes to review prisoners; those guilty of light offenses were released.
s0199.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched on all routes to review prisoners; those guilty of light offenses were released.

s0200.literal: Six thousand households of newly submitted troops garrisoned at Weihui were moved, provisioned at the capital, to fill the granaries.
s0200.idiomatic: 6,000 households of newly submitted troops garrisoned at Weihui were moved, provisioned at the capital, to fill the granaries.
